items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: they say Binzie I think owns that

ctx.x: No, no, no, no, no, no they don't have, I don't think they have no club. The hall is running, you know, for dance and so forth and so on.
Somebody said, I was talking to somebody the other day, they say Binzie I think owns that, doesn't he? Or his brother or something? I don't know, I mean, he might.

He might just own this. But I don't know, I mean, the club never should let it get away from him, you know. They had a nice club one time. Every Sunday evening they had matinee and boxing, you know, and they had card games and, yeah. They had a good time.
